notes: Verified via Wayback Machine snapshot of kurnool.ap.gov.in. 24 pages, 173 KB, 71 PMEGP mentions - the highest PMEGP mention count of any district-level document. Hosted by the Kurnool district portal as part of a recruitment notification download. Contains the full PMEGP scheme guidelines - effectively a district-published copy of the central PMEGP guidelines. This is a major find as it proves district portals were actively distributing PMEGP scheme documentation to prospective applicants.
